residency.offload_kind: none (embedding-on-host is the normal pattern; classifier-secondary misfired — see note)

layers.source: load_tensors: layer N assigned to device — primary dense-residency signal (deduped by layer index)

residency.classification_rule: PRIMARY: layers.cpu_count > 0 -> partial-offload (dense-layer). SECONDARY: host.model_mib > 600 -> partial-offload (expert / MoE). TERTIARY (advisory): host.context_mib > 0 or host.compute_mib > 100 corroborates. Big-vocab boundary compute can false-positive on compute>100 alone, which is why the compute-only signal is tertiary.
residency.classifier_note: PRIMARY layer-count signal: 31/0/31 = full-gpu (no dense-layer offload). SECONDARY host.model_mib (748) tripped the 600 MiB expert-MoE threshold but inspection shows the 748 MiB is the embedding tensor only (gemma4-26B vocab=262144 hidden=5120 IQ4_XS embedding ≈ 671 MiB; 748 ≈ embedding + boundary tensors). MoE config: 128 experts / 8 active per token, all in gpu.model_mib (12952). Classifier 600 MiB threshold was calibrated to 12B embedding (~540 MiB); for 26B+ it needs to scale with hidden_dim or use host_model_pct_of_total (here 5.4%, well below the 10-15% expert-offload signature).
